svg.title: Freidel–Livine states and face-channel dynamics
svg.desc: A fixed-area FL state assigns coherent spinor labels to faces and superposes occupation partitions; hopping can activate additional face channels.
svg.text: FL states label geometry; channel dynamics move area
Spinor data prepare a state over labelled faces. A face-channel Hamiltonian supplies a separate evolution.
1 · Fixed-area FL preparation

svg.title: $F^\dagger_{ij}=a^\dagger_i b^\dagger_j-a^\dagger_j b^\dagger_i\quad\text{creates an SU(2) singlet pair.}$

Spinor directions and norms encode the classical
normal and area proportions of the input geometry.
The total area is fixed; local face areas are in superposition.
Even four labelled faces may be unoccupied in small-area sectors.
evolve
2 · Available face channels
Each graph site is a possible face; occupation sets its area.
input faces
extra channels
Hopping moves bosons between allowed graph sites; U penalizes
double occupation. Closure is preserved in the singlet-sector study.
What the calculations show
Free hopping activates extra channels and recurs; interacting small-area residence depends on interaction strength and preparation.
These finite studies do not establish a channel-count law or large-system thermalization.
